basic_details.job_title: DCPU Kanniyakumari Recruitment 2026 - Apply Offline for District Coordinator and Counsellor Posts

age_limit.details: Maximum Age Limit: 42 years for all posts.

qualification.education_qualification: Post Graduate in Social Work/Sociology/Child Development/Human Rights/Public Administration/Psychology/Mental Health/Law/Public Health/Community Resource Management, Graduate with 2 years experience in Social Welfare sector, Graduate in Social Work/Sociology/Psychology/Public Health/Mental Health, Post Graduate in Counselling and Communication
qualification.details: District Coordinator: Post Graduate Degree in Social Work/Sociology/Child Development/Human Rights/Public Administration/Psychology/Mental Health/Law/Public Health/Community Resource Management from a recognized university OR Graduate Degree in Social Work/Sociology/Child Development/Human Rights/Public Administration with PG Diploma in Women and Child Development/Psychology/Mental Health/Law/Public Health/Community Resource Management and 2 years of experience in project formulation, implementation, monitoring, and supervision in the Social Welfare and Women and Child Development sector. Computer knowledge is required. Counsellor: Graduate Degree in Social Work/Sociology/Psychology/Public Health/Mental Health from a recognized university OR Post Graduate Degree in Counselling and Communication. Minimum 1 year of work experience in a Government organization or NGO. Preference will be given to candidates with experience in Women and Child Development sector and emergency helpline services. Computer knowledge is required.

salary_details.details: District Coordinator: Rs. 28000/- Per Month Counsellor: Rs. 23000/- Per Month

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for DCPU Kanniyakumari Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: www.kanniyakumari.nic.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 05-10-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for DCPU Kanniyakumari Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.kanniyakumari.nic.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 05-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DCPU Kanniyakumari Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the District Coordinator and Counsellor posts is 05 October 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the District Coordinator and Counsellor posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced by the District Child Protection Unit Kanniyakumari for the District Coordinator and Counsellor positions.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the District Coordinator post?
faq.answer: For the District Coordinator post, a Post Graduate Degree in relevant fields like Social Work, Sociology, Child Development, etc., or a Graduate Degree with a PG Diploma and 2 years of experience in the Social Welfare sector is required.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Counsellor position?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Counsellor post is Rs. 23000/- per month. This is a contractual position.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive by DCPU Kanniyakumari.

faq.question: Q6. What is the maximum age limit for applying to these posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for both the District Coordinator and Counsellor posts is 42 years as of 01 September 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for DCPU Kanniyakumari Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process for these posts will primarily involve Document Verification followed by the preparation of a Merit List based on the qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for the DCPU Kanniyakumari Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode is offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it correctly, attach necessary documents, and send it to the official address mentioned in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website for DCPU Kanniyakumari?
faq.answer: The official website for the District Child Protection Unit Kanniyakumari is www.kanniyakumari.nic.in. You can find more details and download the application form from here.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The positions of District Coordinator and Counsellor are on a contractual basis, as per the notification released by DCPU Kanniyakumari.
